```{r}

# Import Libraries

library(tidyverse)
library(tsibble)
library(feasts)
library(skimr)
library(tseries)
```

```{r}

# Import US energy consumption data from Github

raw_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JamesShoenhair/ADS506_Team8/main/release_us_subnational_generation_yearly.csv"

gen_raw <- read_csv(raw_url, show_col_types = FALSE)

head(gen_raw, 20)
```

```{r}

# Cleaning & transformation

# Cleaning variable columns

gen <- gen_raw |>
  rename(
    area             = `Area`,
    iso3             = `ISO 3 code`,
    state            = `State`,
    state_code       = `State code`,
    year             = `Year`,
    source           = `Electricity source`,
    is_aggregate     = `Is aggregated source`,
    gen_twh          = `Generation (TWh)`,
    gen_yoy_twh      = `Generation YoY change (TWh)`,
    gen_yoy_pct      = `Generation YoY change (%)`,
    gen_share_pct    = `Share of generation (%)`,
    gen_share_yoy_pp = `Share of generation YoY change (% points)`,
    emis_mt          = `Emissions (MtCO2e)`,
    emis_yoy_mt      = `Emissions YoY change (MtCO2e)`,
    emis_yoy_pct     = `Emissions YoY change (%)`,
    emis_share_pct   = `Share of emissions (%)`,
    intensity_g_kwh  = `Emissions intensity (gCO2e/kWh)`
  ) |>
  select(-area, -iso3)
```

```{r}

# View top 20 lines after column cleaning

skim(gen)
```

```{r}

# Rows like "Total generation", "Fossil", "Clean", "Renewables" are sums of other rows,
# and "US (total)" is the sum of all states. Keep them apart to avoid double counting.

gen_base   <- gen |> filter(!is_aggregate)
gen_states <- gen |> filter(state != "US (total)")
gen_us     <- gen |> filter(state == "US (total)")
```

```{r}

# Data quality checks
## Duplicates, missing values 

# Duplicates
gen |> count(state, source, year) |> filter(n > 1)
```

```{r}

# Missing values per column
gen |> summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}

# Series with missing years
gen |>
  group_by(state, source) |>
  summarise(first = min(year), last = max(year), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n < max(gen$year) - min(gen$year) + 1)
```

```{r}

# Do individual sources add up to "Total generation"?
gen_base |>
  group_by(state, year) |>
  summarise(sum_sources = sum(gen_twh), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(gen |> filter(source == "Total generation") |> select(state, year, gen_twh),
            by = c("state", "year")) |>
  summarise(max_diff = max(abs(sum_sources - gen_twh)))
```

```{r}

# Extreme YoY % values (usually caused by a near-zero previous year)
gen |> slice_max(gen_yoy_pct, n = 10) |> select(state, year, source, gen_yoy_pct)
```

```{r}

# Convert dataframe to tsiblle

gen_ts <- gen |>
  as_tsibble(key = c(state, source), index = year)

has_gaps(gen_ts) |> filter(.gaps)
```

```{r}

# Visualitations - national trends

us_total <- gen_ts |> filter(state == "US (total)", source == "Total generation")
us_total |> autoplot(gen_twh) + labs(title = "US generation (TWh)")
```

```{r}

us_total |> autoplot(emis_mt) + labs(title = "US emissions (MtCO2e)")
```

```{r}

us_total |> autoplot(intensity_g_kwh) + labs(title = "US emissions intensity (gCO2e/kWh)")
```

```{r}

# US share of energy consumption by source - clean, renewable, fossil fuel
# Includes gruping sources

gen_us_grouped <- gen_us |>
  filter(!is_aggregate) |>
  mutate(source_group = case_when(
    source %in% c("Coal", "Gas", "Other fossil")              ~ "Fossil fuels",
    source == "Nuclear"                                       ~ "Nuclear",
    source %in% c("Wind", "Solar", "Hydro",
                  "Bioenergy", "Other renewables")            ~ "Renewables",
    TRUE                                                      ~ NA_character_
  )) |>
  group_by(year, source_group) |>
  summarise(
    gen_twh       = sum(gen_twh, na.rm = TRUE),
    gen_share_pct = sum(gen_share_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Check: every source got a group (should return 0 rows)
gen_us |> filter(!is_aggregate) |> distinct(source) |>
  filter(!source %in% c("Coal", "Gas", "Other fossil", "Nuclear", "Wind",
                        "Solar", "Hydro", "Bioenergy", "Other renewables"))

gen_us_grouped |>
  ggplot(aes(year, gen_share_pct, colour = source_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "US share of generation by source group (%)",
       x = NULL, y = "Share of generation (%)", colour = NULL)
```

```{r}

# Heatmap of grouped US data

gen_us_grouped |>
  ggplot(aes(year, source_group, fill = gen_share_pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(gen_share_pct, 0)), size = 3, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Share (%)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2001, 2025, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "US share of generation by source group (%)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank())
```

```{r}

# Check for correlations

gen_base |>
  select(gen_twh, gen_share_pct, emis_mt, intensity_g_kwh) |>
  cor(use = "complete.obs")
```

```{r}

# Choose target series

get_series <- function(st = "US (total)", src = "Total generation") {
  gen_ts |> filter(state == st, source == src)
}

y <- get_series()
```

```{r}

# Identifying trend and stationarity

# Yearly data has no seasonality, so focus on trend
y |> gg_tsdisplay(gen_twh, plot_type = "partial", lag_max = 10)

# Unit root tests on levels and first differences
y |> features(gen_twh, list(unitroot_kpss, unitroot_ndiffs))
y |> mutate(d_gen = difference(gen_twh)) |> features(d_gen, unitroot_kpss)

adf.test(y$gen_twh)
adf.test(na.omit(difference(y$gen_twh)))

```

```{r}

# ACF & PACF values of differenced series

y |> mutate(d_gen = difference(gen_twh)) |>
  gg_tsdisplay(d_gen, plot_type = "partial", lag_max = 10)
```
